text:
Samir: Quick thought after the weekend outage  we need a lightweight, enforced remediation flow so items don't linger. Draft below.

Ellie: paste please

Samir: Draft template (minimal):```
owner: <name or team>
owner-contact: pager/email
assigned_ts: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ
due_ts: YYYY-MM-DD
priority: P0/P1/P2
remediation_type: infra/code/process
pm_blocker: true/false
open_remediation: true/false
checkpoints: 48h, 7d, 14d
metrics_to_watch: error-rate,p95-latency,request-rate
rollback_risk: low/med/high
blocked_by: <issue-id>
next_action: short sentence
status: todo/in-progress/blocked/done
labels: <comma-separated>
```

Jamie: Add owner-contact and pm_blocker  good. Also include a short rationale field for audit.

Maria: We should automate nudges. incident-bot can DM the owner at 48h and 7d; ops-bot can post a daily open-remediation digest at 09:00 UTC.

incident-bot: reminder rule: DM owner at 48h and 7d after assigned_ts when open_remediation:true

ops-bot: daily digest enabled for label:remediation. Need consistent label keys to filter.

Lina: IC rotation note: 2-week ICs, voluntary signups, handoff doc updated on Monday 09:00 PT. Keep IC separate from pager.

Tom: Process note  tie remediation to postmortem closure. postmortem remains open if pm_blocker:true. That keeps exec visibility.

Ellie: Can we default owner to service owner or last committer? speeds things up. Also auto-fill assigned_ts when PR merges.

Samir: Proposed rollout plan: 1) add template to runbook (PR today), 2) wire incident-bot rules + ops-bot digest (ops), 3) pilot on one active remediation, 4) iterate after 2 weeks.

Jamie: Schedule a 30-min sync to finalize fields and run the bot flow. Wed 10:30 PT works for me.

Maria: I'll own the ops-bot wiring, ping me on the PR.

Samir: I'll open the PR now and tag this thread. After the pilot, we'll measure time-to-closure and recurrence rate. Thanks everyone.
